channel.title: Adaptavist Cloud Apps incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Adaptavist Cloud Apps's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Caching resolution issue affected small number of script executions [resolved]
item.description:
A small number of scripts failed to run between 9:01am UTC and 9:59am UTC on the 27th Aug 2026.
The issue is now resolved and scripts should be running normally.
This affected ScriptRunner for Jira and Confluence Cloud.
Apologies for any inconvenience caused.

item.title: Script executions delayed in event driven features in SR4JC and SR4CC [resolved]
item.description: We’re confident the ScriptRunner Cloud issues are now resolved, so we’re closing this incident. If you experience any further issues, please contact our team.

item.title: Requests to Atlassian REST APIs experiencing increased rate limiting [resolved]
item.description: Between 10:15 and 10:30 UTC, customers using ScriptRunner for Jira Cloud or Enhanced Search apps may have experienced increased rate limiting when accessing Jira REST APIs from their scripts, other automations or JQL searches. This was caused by a gradual release of Atlassian's new authentication mechanism for requests made as individual users. We rolled back the changes and apologise for any disruption.

item.title: Conditions and validators not loading on Jira workflows draft screen [resolved]
item.description:
The issue is caused by the deprecation of the legacy workflows page https://community.atlassian.com/forums/Jira-Cloud-Admins-articles/Final-notice-old-workflow-editor-deprecation-in-July-2026/ba-p/3247499
For users to edit their conditions and validators they will need to follow the instructions above to use the new workflow editor experience or edit their conditions and validators via the ScriptRunner Workflows Admin Page
Thanks!

item.title: Smart Designer - Crashing when no Brand Kits available [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: ScriptRunner DC to Cloud migration failures [resolved]
item.description: ScriptRunner Cloud migrations are operating normally. The underlying issue has been addressed, and we are monitoring the system to ensure continued stability. Thank you for your patience.

item.title: Intermittent caching errors causing app settings to temporarily revert to default values in some cases [resolved]
item.description: Our monitoring has confirmed the fix has worked. We’ll continue reviewing the incident to help prevent recurrence. Once more, we apologise for any inconvenience caused and thank you for your patience.

item.title: Certain Form fields fail to be saved in Forms builder and Quiz builder [resolved]
item.description:
Our monitoring has now confirmed that the issue with the Forms for Confluence service, causing errors in some forms has been resolved and that all systems and services are operating normally.
We’ll continue reviewing the incident to help prevent recurrence.
Once more, we apologise for any inconvenience caused and thank you for your patience.

item.title: Custom macro editing and deletion fails for Scriptrunner for confluence cloud [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been fixed and the fix has been deployed. We are now monitoring the situation.

item.title: Identified an issue affecting a minority of script executions [resolved]
item.description: At 13:21 28th May 2026 to 07:34 29th May 2026 UTC, there was an issue affecting script executions.

item.title: Script Manager invisible to customer [resolved]
item.description: Script Manager was unaccessible for a few hours between approximately 13:00 UTC and 22:00 UTC on 2026-05-05. Its visibility and accessibility have been restored. Script executions were unaffected.

item.title: Atlassian delays in webhook delivery [resolved]
item.description: Atlassian published an update to their status page that their monitoring confirmed the issue with delays in delivering events is now resolved

item.title: Filter syncing delays in ScriptRunner Enhanced Search in US [resolved]
item.description: We experienced delays in automated filter syncing for ScriptRunner for Jira Enhanced Search customers in the US from 19:57 UTC to 22:00 UTC. Some filter results may have been out of date during this period for some customers. A work around was available at this time by manually syncing the filter from the Enhanced Search page. We apologise for the disruption and are implementing architecture changes to improve the stability of this service.
